from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """An extracted record for one paper in the collection, capturing what it cites."""
    paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper this document represents")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly cites; empty list if none found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction results for the collection of papers."""
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
